name: fibona-agent
description: Fibona's core in JavaScript: the model writes the next cell of the program it runs in.

scripts.build: cp ../agent_assets/openai_responses_api_docs.json ../LICENSE . && tsup src/agent.ts --format esm,iife --global-name Fibona --minify --clean && tsc
scripts.release: npm pack && gh release create js-v$npm_package_version fibona-agent-$npm_package_version.tgz --title "fibona-agent (JS) $npm_package_version" --notes-file README.md
